attributes.board_name: Ohio Counselor, Social Worker and Marriage and Family Therapist Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs meeting OAC 4757-9-05 and 4757-9-06: board-approved providers/programs, programs approved by other states' boards issuing the same license types, programs offered/approved by national associations representing the professions, qualifying college courses; authoring (max 10 h) and presentations/teaching (max 10 h per period).
rules.carryover: No banking: effective July 1, 2026, excess hours from the prior renewal period can no longer be applied (previously up to 12).
rules.notes: All hours may be earned by distance learning (OAC 4757-9-04(F)). License expires two years from issue or renewal (OAC 4757-7-01). LPCCs may claim up to 6 hours of qualifying volunteer service.
